title: AdapterFusion source-adapter bank compression with Mirror views
hypothesis: A per-source Givens coordinate over one shared rank-4 adapter basis can compress a bank of independently trained source adapters while preserving target fusion quality, and will occupy a better quality/byte point than hard tying and scalar gates.
physical_object: Frozen linear feature interface with eight rank-4 bottleneck residual adapters trained for eight source tasks; four target tasks fuse those source adapter outputs through learned input-conditioned softmax attention.
mirror_coordinate: Six Givens angles per source task composing an SO(4) transform between a shared down projection and up projection; view is applied inside the bottleneck adapter, before projection back to feature space.
logical_multiplicity: Eight logical source-task adapters, jointly available to four input-conditioned target fusion tasks.
prior_art_delta: PA54 AdapterFusion keeps independently trained source adapters frozen and learns a separate fusion mechanism. This screen tests whether the source adapter bank can be represented as shared bottleneck factors plus per-source views, while preserving the same target fusion interface.

methods: independent rank-4 source adapters + learned fusion router
one hard-tied rank-4 source adapter + learned fusion router
shared rank-4 basis + one scalar per source + learned fusion router
shared rank-4 basis + unrestricted 4x4 coefficient matrix per source + learned fusion router
shared rank-4 basis + six-angle Givens Mirror code per source + learned fusion router
model.training_schedule: At every source update, all methods receive the same sampled minibatch and all eight source-task targets; source-bank losses are averaged over tasks. Source banks are then frozen. For each target task, the same minibatches and update count train an 8-way linear softmax fusion router; fusion/router state is separately measured and included in payload.

teacher.source_operator: B0 @ Q_i @ A0, with A0 and B0 shared within each world and Q_i generated by six fixed-plane Givens rotations; this is a deliberately aligned feasibility screen, not a natural task distribution.
teacher.target_operator: Input-conditioned softmax mixture of the eight source adapter outputs, with a fixed target-specific router generated per world.
teacher.data: Fresh independent Gaussian feature examples; target values are generated deterministically from the world-specific source operators and router.

controls: full independent rank-4 adapter bank (mandatory AdapterFusion storage/quality upper control)
shared adapter plus per-source scalar gate
shared adapter basis plus unrestricted per-source 4x4 coefficients (generic low-rank control)
shared adapter basis plus per-source Givens Mirror view

development.selection_metric: mean target-fusion test NRMSE across four target tasks, with source-task NRMSE and actual serialized total inference bytes as required secondary metrics
development.allowed_tuning: No hyperparameter selection is planned. The fixed architecture/update/optimizer specification is evaluated once; any implementation correction must rerun only development seeds before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: independent source-bank mean NRMSE <=0.03; Mirror mean target-fusion NRMSE <= independent-bank +0.02 and <=0.10 absolute; Mirror actual total payload <=0.60x independent; Mirror must improve target NRMSE over scalar by >=0.01 at no more than 1.10x scalar bytes; no generic 4x4 control may match Mirror within 0.005 NRMSE at <= Mirror bytes. If any gate fails, fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes measured from disk after reload
paid_objects: all source adapter shared or independent weights
all per-source Givens angles, scalar gates, or coefficient matrices
all per-target fusion router weights and biases
all model/task dimensions and reconstruction metadata
NPZ names, headers and compression overhead

success_gate: All three fresh worlds satisfy the development quality/byte/fusion gates; Mirror is not dominated by the unrestricted coefficient control at an equal or smaller payload; exact serialized reload and metric replay pass.
failure_gate: Mirror misses the quality or 60% independent-bank byte gate, the scalar control matches or beats target fusion quality at comparable bytes, or the generic coefficient control matches Mirror quality within 0.005 NRMSE at no greater payload.
boundaries: synthetic frozen linear-feature AdapterFusion proxy; no pretrained Transformer or natural-language claim
the shared-orbit teacher is intentionally aligned to the Mirror family and only tests a feasibility upper bound
source-bank quality, target fusion quality, fusion state bytes and compute are reported separately
fixed optimizer updates do not establish near-converged capacity
eight adapters and four fusion tasks do not imply independent capacity
